description: This file defines the 'SubjectNode' class, a specific implementation of 'PolicyTreeNode' for representing subject nodes within a policy tree structure. It includes methods for creating, accessing, and manipulating subject nodes, as well as visitor pattern support.

classes.name: SubjectNode
classes.description: A final class representing a subject node in a policy tree, supporting naming, child management, and visitor acceptance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectNode instance with the given name after checking for null validity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subject node.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the node, which is 'SUBJECT'.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves an optional child node by resource name.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this subject node.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing this node and its children.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the map of children of this node.
